parts.name: Toast / ToastItem
parts.description: A controlled toast; ToastItem is an alias of Toast. Use one ToastProvider per app and remove records in onExitComplete, after setting open=false. Rich and simple variants can share the same viewport.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled visibility. Set false when a close request is received.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with false for dismissal. Update open first and retain the record until onExitComplete.

props.name: onExitComplete
props.description: Called after the closed toast unmounts following its exit animation. Remove its record here, not in onOpenChange.

props.name: variant
props.description: rich supports description/action; simple forbids both and uses an inline icon and close action.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic palette and icon: info, success, warning or error.

props.name: toneLabel
props.description: Localized accessible tone label; visible in rich headers and announced in simple toasts.

props.name: description
props.description: Additional text for variant="rich" only. Not accepted by the simple variant.

props.name: action
props.description: Rich-only action label and callback. The action also dismisses the toast.

props.name: duration
props.description: Auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds. Omitted inherits the Provider (5000ms by default); false persists until dismissed.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the built-in close action.

parts.name: ToastProvider
parts.description: Provides timing, swipe handling and one shared viewport. Each toast can override duration. Hover, focus and window blur pause auto-dismiss and resume the remaining time.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default auto-dismiss delay in milliseconds; false makes toasts persistent. Individual toast duration takes precedence.

props.name: viewportLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the shared viewport; overrides its Radix default.

props.name: label
props.description: Radix announcement label used with foreground toast announcements.

props.name: swipeDirection
props.description: Direction that dismisses an individual toast by swipe.

props.name: swipeThreshold
props.description: Minimum swipe distance in pixels before dismissal.

props.name: announcerContainer
props.description: Optional portal destination for the toast live announcer.

props.name: children
props.description: Application/toast children sharing this provider and its single viewport.
